notes.title: Next Update: Rogue Mode
notes.notes:
The game will update the 28th of July.
Key new features:

-New game mode: ROGUE (with procedurally generated missions and progression)
-A new cockpit monitor called the FMS (flight management system)
-The new surface region 'Sigen Delta'
-The new surface region ‘Brume Larsen’
-Custom Nav markers (FMS - Rogue Mode)
-The ‘Ship Type Locator’ tool (FMS - Rogue Mode)
-New dock platforms and updated orbital stations Dalby, Galdar, Fenton, Cohagen and Montana
-New UI meter (ExoDetec) in addition to beacon sound during search missions
-Improved clouds textures for high orbits (above 450 km altitude)
-Several bug fixes
- ...

In Rogue Mode:
-we complete missions to gain pilot rating
-we can manage messages and missions during flight (via FMS)
-we can load more than one cargo (CF2/EX5 ships)
-we can have multiple missions active
-as the pilot rating improves, we get more challenging missions
-we can get missions from almost anywhere on the planet and orbit
